body:
This request comes from the ClinGen Hereditary Cardiovascular Disease Gene Curation Expert Panel (GCEP): https://www.clinicalgenome.org/affiliation/40104/ 

We are lumping several cardiac phenotypes associated with SCN5A into one new term. Below we provide the information for the updates and reorganization of the terms. 

1. New Mondo term: SCN5A-related cardiac rhythm disorder

Parent terms for the new term to reside under:
cardiogenetic disease (MONDO:0100547)
cardiac rhythm disease MONDO:0007263
New proposed Parent term: cardiogenetic rhythm disorders (Details provided below)

Phenotypes (Child terms) INCLUDED under the new term include: 
Atrial fibrillation, familial, 10 MIM: 614022 (MONDO:0013530)
Sick sinus syndrome 1 MIM: 608567 (MONDO:0024562)
Ventricular fibrillation, familial, 1 MIM: 603829 (MONDO:0011376)
Long QT syndrome 3 MIM: 603830 (MONDO:0011377)
Brugada syndrome 1 MIM: 601144 (MONDO:0011001)

Phenotypes EXCLUDED but still associated with SCN5A: 
{Sudden infant death syndrome, susceptibility to} MIM: 272120
Heart block, nonprogressive MIM: 113900
Heart block, progressive, type IA MIM: 113900
Cardiomyopathy, dilated, 1E MIM: 601154


New term description for SCN5A-related cardiac rhythm disorder:

A heterogeneous collection of cardiac rhythm disorders caused by genetic variation in the SCN5A gene with autosomal dominant inheritance. Affected individuals are commonly reported to have unremarkable cardiac morphology and at least one cardiac rhythm phenotype that includes, but is not limited to, atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, progressive cardiac conduction disease, ventricular fibrillation, long QT syndrome, Brugada syndrome, and multifocal ectopic Purkinje-related premature contractions. Individuals with pathogenic variants in SCN5A may also exhibit overlapping or mixed cardiac rhythm phenotypes and intrafamilial variability.



2. New proposed Parent term: cardiogenetic rhythm disorders

Cardiogenetic rhythm disorders new term information:

Parent term for cardiogenetic rhythm disorders to reside under: cardiogenetic disease (MONDO:0100547)

Child terms of cardiogenetic rhythm disorders: 
atrial conduction disease (MONDO:0014500)
atrioventricular block (MONDO:0000465)
Brugada syndrome (MONDO:0015263)
familial atrial fibrillation (MONDO:0018054)
familial sick sinus syndrome (MONDO:0012061)
progressive familial heart block (MONDO:0019490)
short QT syndrome (MONDO:0000453)
ventricular tachycardia, familial (MONDO:0008648)
ventricular fibrillation, familial (MONDO:0011376)

Disease description: A heterogeneous group of cardiac rhythm phenotypes with a monogenic etiology that include, but are not limited to, atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, progressive cardiac conduction disease, ventricular fibrillation, Brugada syndrome, long QT syndrome, short QT syndrome, and multifocal ectopic Purkinje-related premature contractions, tachycardia with fibrillation, etc.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Please remove "multifocal ectopic Purkinje-related premature contractions" from the terms definitions as we are still evaluating the gene-disease association. Please use the revised definitions as below.

New term description for SCN5A-related cardiac rhythm disorder:
A heterogeneous collection of cardiac rhythm disorders caused by genetic variation in the SCN5A gene with autosomal dominant inheritance. Affected individuals are commonly reported to have unremarkable cardiac morphology and at least one cardiac rhythm phenotype that includes, but is not limited to, atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, progressive cardiac conduction disease, ventricular fibrillation, long QT syndrome, and Brugada syndrome. Individuals with pathogenic variants in SCN5A may also exhibit overlapping or mixed cardiac rhythm phenotypes and intrafamilial variability.

New term description for Cardiogenetic rhythm disorders: 
A heterogeneous group of cardiac rhythm phenotypes with a monogenic etiology that include, but are not limited to, atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, progressive cardiac conduction disease, ventricular fibrillation, Brugada syndrome, long QT syndrome, short QT syndrome, tachycardia with fibrillation, etc.

@LengUNC - thank you for this request! I have added the two new terms with the definitions that you provided. 

For the children of 'cardiogenetic rhythm disorder' I was able to include all of the terms that you requested EXCEPT atrioventricular block (MONDO:0000465) because this condition does not necessarily have a monogenic etiology. 

Please let me know if you require an additional new term that is specifically 'monogenic atrioventricular block'. If so, please kindly provide a source such as PMID or clin gen working group.

Thank you!

title: Mondo request for SCN5A disease entity for ClinGen
